problem: The existing fingerprinted, atomic, zero-retry Together create path bound the Hugging Face repository name but not an immutable HF commit revision or explicit training random seed. A mutable model ref could therefore change checkpoint bytes without changing the intended model name, and seed provenance was implicit rather than campaign-bound.

checkpoint_identity.custom_model_policy: A custom CLAYCOG_HF_MODEL requires an explicit exact 40-hex CLAYCOG_HF_REVISION.

delta: Campaign fingerprint now binds exact hf_model_revision, learning rate, warmup ratio and random_seed in addition to the existing dataset digests/model/template/epochs/evals/training type/checkpoint count.
Atomic create-intent ledger schema advanced to v2 and stores the same revision- and seed-bound campaign descriptor.
Billed create passes hf_model_revision and explicit random_seed to Together while preserving max_retries=0 and UNKNOWN_REMOTE_CREATE fail-closed semantics.

After a returned job id, JOB_KNOWN is durably persisted before provider identity verification. The follow-up retrieve checks training/validation file ids, template, from_hf_model, hf_model_revision, epochs, evals and random_seed; mismatch or verification transport failure blocks replacement create and preserves the known job id.

isolated_regression.surface: authorized isolated local Linux execution reconstructed from exact Git blobs
isolated_regression.git_clone_attempt: NETWORK_ADMISSION_BLOCKED_DNS; not classified as code failure

external_contract_basis.together_byom: Current Together BYOM supports specifying an HF checkpoint revision and requires architecture-compatible training template selection; authenticated service admission remains open.
external_contract_basis.together_create: Current fine-tuning create contract exposes hf_model_revision and random_seed.
external_contract_basis.hf_revision_pins: Resolved current public Hugging Face commit identities were captured before this delta.

claim_boundary: This proves bounded launcher reproducibility/safety mechanisms only. It does not prove a qwen2-compatible Together Full-FT template exists, BYOM compatibility, authenticated preflight, paid training start, checkpoint quality, OOD promotion, quantized RSS, native 0.7 acceptance, consciousness or whole Mini Entity PASS.
next: Merge without replacing newer parallel Together safety work. With an authorized mounted API key, first enumerate/admit a qwen2-compatible Full-FT template before upload; if none exists, do not spend. If admitted, run exact fingerprinted preflight and exactly one budget-gated create.
